name: Junior Docents at the NM Museum of Natural History and Science
org: New Mexico Museum of Natural History and Science
what_you_do: Teens work in the museum's exhibit halls. They talk with visitors about science, help at events and can pick a special project.
who_can_apply: Teens ages 13 to 17 who are entering 7th through 12th grade.
pay_detail: Teens pay a $175 fee. Limited financial help is available.
duration: Training week June 1 to 5. Work period June 8 to July 31 (2026 session). Typical commitment is two 4-hour shifts a week.
deadline_text: The 2026 deadline was May 15, 2026. The program page says to check back in January 2027 for the 2027 program.
how_to_apply: Fill out the online application linked on the program page. Questions go to the Junior Docent Coordinator, Sioux Rivera. The page says applications are closed.
notes: Unpaid and costs $175. The 2026 session had a required training week June 1 to 5. Contact is the Junior Docent Coordinator listed on the program page. Applications were closed on the page when checked.
